cases.text: Sixty metres is incredibly low. I am uncomfortable with that height.
Fifteen flights a day would mean constant humming while I relax. I oppose that sound, but would accept quieter flights.
How will helicopters and drones be kept apart in that crowded sky? I could accept it if their movements are coordinated safely.
There is not enough room for all those competing flights. I oppose adding more until somebody coordinates which aircraft can use the limited space.
Route them over the industrial park so they cannot look into my windows. I oppose the cameras viewing my home.
I oppose allocating our community garden to a landing pad. Use an existing hospital roof instead and that facility location would be acceptable.
Even if all my other issues were solved, the original noise alone would make me reject this route. I could accept it if the noise were inaudible.
